title: National Partnership Emails — 2014
notes: The archive contains explicit named NP committee rosters in addition to Additions lists.
Mike Khandjian is explicitly called an 'NP member and organizer of The Fellowship Dinner'; the same passage says the Fellowship was completely independent of the NP but had a high degree of overlap.
Committee rosters prefaced as current names of NP on the Committee of Commissioners are treated as direct membership evidence for the named men at that date.
Running totals fluctuate during the year, so raw occurrences are preserved and normalized separately from membership-count arithmetic.
